title: A board of two resistors and a header, summarised
how: Counted from the file: 4 layer lines; 3 element lines (parts); 2 signal lines (nets);
routed items are the wire and via children of the signals: GND has wire, wire, via and SIG has wire, so 4;
1 library is embedded; every child of board is one the reader knows, so nothing is left uninterpreted.
